statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The service is consistent with diagnoses I49.5 and I48.0.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
